The '''B1-SAL Probe Droid''' was a model of floating cube-shaped [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="LotS" />

These droids were plated in a [[Color/Legends|red]] color. The droid's had a [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] featuring an orange ring. It also moved utilizing a built-in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]].<ref name="LotS" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Concept artist [[Bradley W. Lewis]] designed the B1-SAL Probe Droid for the "Inspired By" Andor tie-in content<ref name="Concept">{{ArtStation|username=nonentity|url=artwork/m8GNYv|name=[[Bradley W. Lewis|Bradley Lewis]]|text=SWTOR &#124; B1-SAL Salvage Droid Minipet &#124; 3D Print & Paint|date=2024-07-25|quote=This is a 3D Print of the in-game model for B1-Sal, the minipet I designed for our "Inspired By" Andor tie-in content.}}</ref> in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="LotS" /> Its design was heavily inspired by the [[droid]] [[B2EMO]] from [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor|Andor]]'',<ref name="Andor">''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''</ref> which itself was designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], with help from animatronic designer [[Josh Lee]]<ref name="B2EMO">{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1550614788119711746|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2022-07-22|quote=Very. The final design was a result of working very closely with animatronic designer Josh Lee throughout so there were never any unforeseen surprises. The final design is a complete product of my aesthetic and Josh's technical inputs.}}</ref> and creature designer [[Neal Scanlan]].<ref name="SDCC">{{SW|url=news/lucasfilm-pavilion-sdcc-2022|text=SDCC 2022: ''Andor'' Costumes Revealed at the Lucasfilm Pavilion}}</ref>

Some ''The Old Republic'' players were mistakenly gifted a B1-SAL Probe Droid minipet<ref name="B1-SAL">{{TORweb|subdomain=forums|url=topic/929094-jr-4-recon-droid-mini-pet|text=JR-4 RECON DROID MINI-PET|date=2023-04-28}}</ref> instead of a [[JR-4 Recon Droid]] during the ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]'' celebration login event that ran between [[April 28]] and [[May 3]], [[2023]], though this was later amended.<ref name="Survivor">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230428|text=Celebrate the Launch of ''Star Wars'' Jedi: Survivor™ with a Free Mini-pet!|date=2023-04-28}}</ref>
